name: Mohamed Tarek Abdelhady Portfolio Agent
description: AI agent for Mohamed Tarek Abdelhady's portfolio. Provides access to engineering calculators, project information, services, and tools for electronics and communication engineering.

skills.name: Ohm's Law Calculator
skills.description: Calculate voltage, current, resistance, or power using Ohm's Law (V=IR). Enter any two values to compute the remaining two.

skills.name: Resistor Color Code Calculator
skills.description: Calculate resistor values from color bands. Supports 4-band and 5-band resistor codes.

skills.name: LED Resistor Calculator
skills.description: Calculate the correct resistor value for LED circuits based on supply voltage, forward voltage, and desired current.

skills.name: Capacitor Calculator
skills.description: Calculate capacitor values including RC time constant, reactance, and energy storage.

skills.name: Wire Gauge Calculator
skills.description: Calculate wire gauge (AWG) based on current, voltage drop, and wire length requirements.

skills.name: Project Information
skills.description: Access details about engineering and web development projects in the portfolio.

skills.name: Services Information
skills.description: Learn about engineering services offered: web development, Arduino programming, PCB design, embedded systems.

skills.name: x402 HTTP Payment Protocol
skills.description: Agent-native HTTP payments via x402 protocol on Base Sepolia. Protected routes return HTTP 402.

skills.name: Machine Payment Protocol (MPP)
skills.description: MPP payment discovery via /openapi.json x-payment-info extensions. Protected routes return HTTP 402.

skills.name: DNS for AI Discovery (DNS-AID)
skills.description: DNS-based agent discovery via ServiceMode SVCB and HTTPS records under _agents namespace.

skills.name: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)
skills.description: UCP merchant profile and dev.ucp.shopping transport at /.well-known/ucp and /api/ucp.

skills.name: Markdown for Agents
skills.description: Content negotiation returning text/markdown when Accept: text/markdown is requested.
